fix_instructions: The scenario is currently too easy; however, since no checks leaked via hidden information (all passing checks were based on public facts), the failure is due to the model solving the task using only public information. To make the scenario require multi-agent coordination, tighten the requirements for C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, and C9 so they cannot be satisfied by generic platform policies (like S6/S7) and strictly require the specific numeric or named values contained in PF1, PF2, and PF3.
